scope: Enable the LibXR internal flash database and persist BMI088 gyro zero offset and gimbal yaw calibration across resets

changes.generator: User/libxr_config.yaml database.enable=false -> true, block_size=32 -> auto; regenerated User/app_main.cpp with STM32Flash and DatabaseRaw<STM32Flash::MIN_WRITE_SIZE> registered as database
changes.wiring: BMI088 database argument imu_ram_database -> database in both profiles; sentry_remote Gimbal calibration_database nullptr -> &database; gimbal template updated
changes.kept: User/imu_ram_database.hpp and its host regression remain as the RAM-only fallback backend
